name: 深色金匾风Q弹虾仁款
description: 深色灶朴风虾仁套图：鎏金主图、Q弹肌理微距、参数信任与金环收口

styleLock.direction: dark rustic premium seafood commerce with gilt accent
styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep espresso brown-black rustic backdrop #1A120C; indigo batik cloth #2B3A55 and dark walnut wood #2A1B10 for food scenes; thin gold-framed inset photo panels on infographic screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm low-key studio spotlight, 3000K-3400K upper-side key, deep soft shadows, glistening specular highlights on fresh flesh, soft contact shadows under tableware
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark textured ceramic bowls and plates #211812, dark walnut wood table #2A1B10, matte indigo batik cloth #2B3A55
styleLock.typography: one bold serif display family for gilt gold headlines, clean sans-serif for small labels; no handwritten, retro or cartoon fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: solid gold circular badges with simple flat glyphs, single accent style
styleLock.presentationRules: fresh peeled shrimp meat pieces piled loosely in dark ceramic tableware, plump and glistening, no packaging; stable high-angle food styling; inset photo panels always thin gold-framed with rounded corners
noDrift: no mismatched icon or badge styles
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark rustic premium seafood visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep espresso brown-black #1A120C, gilt gold #D9A441, pale shrimp pink #F2D5C9 and seal red #B03A24; warm low-key lighting with a 3000K-3400K upper-side key, deep soft shadows and glistening highlights; one bold serif display family for gilt gold headlines with clean sans-serif labels only; solid gold circular badge icons in one flat style; dark textured ceramic tableware, dark walnut wood and indigo batik cloth surfaces; thin gold-framed inset photo panels on infographic screens; fresh loose shrimp-meat styling with stable high-angle presentation; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random bright backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon or badge styles.

shots.intent: 首屏承接点击，用深色灶朴氛围和鎏金标题一秒立住食欲主视觉
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at a dark ceramic bowl, bowl in the lower two thirds of the frame, full bowl visible
shots.lighting: warm 3200K spotlight from the upper left, deep soft shadows, glistening highlights, soft contact shadow under the bowl
shots.background: deep espresso brown-black rustic backdrop #1A120C with a corner of indigo batik cloth #2B3A55
shots.props: two dried red chilies and one star anise at the frame edges, not covering the bowl
shots.textZone: top zone one gilt gold #D9A441 serif headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with two small seal-red #B03A24 round badges 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 beside it
shots.promptTemplate: Dark rustic e-commerce hero shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at a dark textured ceramic bowl piled loosely with fresh plump glistening pieces, the bowl placed in the lower two thirds and filling 65-75% of the frame, full bowl visible. Warm 3200K spotlight from the upper left, deep soft shadows, glistening specular highlights, soft contact shadow grounding the bowl. Background deep espresso brown-black #1A120C with a corner of indigo batik cloth #2B3A55. Props limited to two dried red chilies and one star anise at the frame edges. The top zone completes the composition with one gilt gold #D9A441 serif headline 「{selling_point_1}」 flanked by two small seal-red #B03A24 round badges carrying 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. 2K commercial food e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand names, no logos, no watermarks, no packaging, no hands, no boats, no fabricated origin or test claims, no clutter behind the bowl, no cut-off edges, no extra text.

shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro food shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. provenance.notes: 8 屏(800x1200)深色灶朴风虾仁详情长图提炼。图为去壳开背生虾肉、主打锁鲜与口感，属生鲜水产，归「生鲜粮油/海鲜」而非食品饮料/速食（同库先例：单冻海参、大闸蟹均在生鲜粮油）。已剥离品牌字与虾形标识、全部原文案与数值（标题/规格/克重/冷链话术）、二维码与店铺会员角标、水域照片中的船只；规格与卖点一律改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 文案槽，溯源场景改为无船只自然水域。
